batch_info.quality_assessment: Boilerplate instructional content with limited actionable extraction

portion_doctrine: Series 3 segments 41-50 are transcribed Photoshop tutorial videos (30 Days of Photoshop series + Pro Tutorials). Content is primarily instructional UI navigation and step-by-step feature walkthroughs. Minimal philosophy, doctrine, or strategic insight. Heavy on demo narration with video timestamps. Marginally applicable to SNIPED visual direction (some color grading, compositing, layer masking principles apply broadly to photography post-production, but no specific doctrine or novel methods present).
core_operating_rules: Adjustment layers = non-destructive editing (turn off/on, adjust settings, layer masks control visibility)
Smart filters enable re-entry into Camera Raw settings post-application
Curves > Levels for granular midpoint control; curves allow S-curve contrast manipulation
Layer masks preserve original image data; deletion/destruction only applies to mask, not underlying pixels
Hue/Saturation + eyedropper = precise color target selection for color replacement workflows
Generative fill (Adobe Firefly) removes distractions with one click; selection + blank prompt auto-infers removal
Gradient maps at 10-20% opacity for color toning/unification on composites
Lens blur in Camera Raw auto-detects subject + allows bokeh type selection
Radial gradient masking focuses adjustment brightness to image center (vignette effect)
LUTs (Look-Up Tables) = exportable adjustment layer stacks for cross-software color grading
Landscape masking auto-selects sky/mountains/ground for targeted adjustments

gates: Generative fill requires selection boundary (cannot apply to full canvas without marquee)
Hue/Saturation color selection can over-select similar colors in non-target areas (requires mask refinement)
Generative fill resolution degradation on large/complex removals (scaffolding, crowds)
Gradient map reversal often needed (click 'reverse' if output looks inverted)
Layer mask feathering required to avoid hard edges in vignettes
Smart objects must be created BEFORE Camera Raw application to enable re-entry
